1.web: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
1.asv: O give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.

2.web: Let the redeemed by Yahweh say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
2.asv: Let the redeemed of Jehovah sayso, Whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

3.web: And gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
3.asv: And gathered out of the lands, From the east and from the west, From the north and from the south.

4.web: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.
4.asv: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way; They found no city of habitation.

5.web: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
5.asv: Hungry and thirsty, Their soul fainted in them.

6.web: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses,
6.asv: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he delivered them out of their distresses,

7.web: he led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.
7.asv: He led them also by a straight way, That they might go to a city of habitation.

8.web: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works to the children of men!
8.asv: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!

9.web: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
9.asv: For he satisfieth the longing soul, And the hungry soul he filleth with good.

10.web: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,
10.asv: Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, Being bound in affliction and iron,

11.web: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.
11.asv: Because they rebelled against the words of God, And contemned the counsel of the Most High:

12.web: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.
12.asv: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor; They fell down, and there was none to help.

13.web: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
13.asv: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he saved them out of their distresses.

14.web: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.
14.asv: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, And brake their bonds in sunder.

15.web: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works to the children of men!
15.asv: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!

16.web: For he has broken the gates of brass, and cut through bars of iron.
16.asv: For he hath broken the gates of brass, And cut the bars of iron in sunder.

17.web: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.
17.asv: Fools because of their transgression, And because of their iniquities, are afflicted.

18.web: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.
18.asv: Their soul abhorreth all manner of food; And they draw near unto the gates of death.

19.web: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, he saves them out of their distresses.
19.asv: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he saveth them out of their distresses.

20.web: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.
20.asv: He sendeth his word, and healeth them, And delivereth them from their destructions.

21.web: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works to the children of men!
21.asv: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!

22.web: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with singing.
22.asv: And let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, And declare his works with singing.

23.web: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters;
23.asv: They that go down to the sea in ships, That do business in great waters;

24.web: These see Yahweh’s works, and his wonders in the deep.
24.asv: These see the works of Jehovah, And his wonders in the deep.

25.web: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
25.asv: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, Which lifteth up the waves thereof.

26.web: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.
26.asv: They mount up to the heavens, they go down again to the depths: Their soul melteth away because of trouble.

27.web: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
27.asv: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, And are at their wits’ end.

28.web: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.
28.asv: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he bringeth them out of their distresses.

29.web: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.
29.asv: He maketh the storm a calm, So that the waves thereof are still.

30.web: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
30.asv: Then are they glad because they are quiet; So he bringeth them unto their desired haven.

31.web: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works for the children of men!
31.asv: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!

32.web: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.
32.asv: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, And praise him in the seat of the elders.

33.web: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,
33.asv: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, And watersprings into a thirsty ground;

34.web: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
34.asv: A fruitful land into a salt desert, For the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

35.web: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.
35.asv: He turneth a wilderness into a pool of water, And a dry land into watersprings.

36.web: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,
36.asv: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, That they may prepare a city of habitation,

37.web: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.
37.asv: And sow fields, and plant vineyards, And get them fruits of increase.

38.web: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.
38.asv: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; And he suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

39.web: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
39.asv: Again, they are diminished and bowed down Through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

40.web: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
40.asv: He poureth contempt upon princes, And causeth them to wander in the waste, where there is no way.

41.web: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.
41.asv: Yet setteth he the needy on high from affliction, And maketh him families like a flock.

42.web: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.
42.asv: The upright shall see it, and be glad; And all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

43.web: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of Yahweh.
43.asv: Whoso is wise will give heed to these things; And they will consider the lovingkindnesses of Jehovah.
